title: Malaad budul yàkkamti
intro: Ci taarixu yonent yi, ñu néew ñoo muñ ñàkkaale yu metti yu mel nii, ak metit yu metti yu mel noonu, ànd ak ngëm gu dëgër. Jaar-jaaru nit ki dafay jàngale muñ ak wóolu xam-xam bu Yàlla jox. Kan mooy xol bii?
clues: Yàlla tànn nama ngir ma yónnee mesaas, waaye sama natt bu gëna mag nekkul woon ci bañ, waaye ci sama musiba.
Sama alal, sama baayima ak samay doom, ñu nangu leen benn-benn.
Sama yaram dafa fees dell ak ay gaañ-gaañu, ma des man kese ludul sama jabar.
Ma yuuxu sama Boroom, nangu sama tiis, sàkku yërmaandeem.
Dañu ma wax ma dóor sama tànk ci suuf, mu génn ci ndox mu féexal xol.
Yalla delloosi sama wérgi-yaram, may ma njaboot gu bees ak alal ju ëpp lima amoon.

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Ñu tàqale leen ak seeni mbokk, jaay leen ñuy jaam
ñu natt ko ak naat bu wurus

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Jot doom bu góor ci màgget

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
